title: 第19章 突破炼气二层第20章 想换几个热水瓶
content_zh:
张昊宇一睁眼，天还黑着呢，抬手一看表，才五点！
他一个闪身钻进空间，“咕嘟”吞下一滴灵液，麻溜地开始修炼“玄天长生诀”。
两个小时后，他感觉自己要突破了，赶忙又用意念取了一滴灵液服下，接着修炼了一个多小时，“砰”的一下，突破到炼气二层了！
他感觉到自己的身体发生了巨大的变化，不仅力量增加了一倍。
身体也变得壮实了很多，身高居然还长高了一点，现在都有1米76了！精神力更是增强了不少！
张昊宇来到院子里，试了试，速度居然也增加了一倍！
他兴奋地练了一遍拳，哇塞，武功也突破暗劲了！具体有多强呢？
他自己重生以来还没跟人打过架呢，不过感觉比前世强大！
他用意念清理了一下身体，来到仓库，把公安学校的课本用神识扫描了一遍，然后出了空间看了一眼手表，才过去几分钟而已……
张昊宇躺在床上，美滋滋地消化着公安学校课本上的知识。
对他来说，这些知识简直太简单了！这个年代的公安，大部分都是转业军人，好多人连字都不认识呢！更别提文化知识了！
两个小不点跑了过来，“二锅，二锅……”
张昊宇一把将两个小不点抱到床上，和他们玩闹了一会儿，然后起床穿衣服。
“哎呀，衣服怎么变小了这么多！”
“娘……”母亲听到他喊自己，急忙跑过来问：“小宇，你起床了就快去洗漱，喊我有啥事？”
“娘，用鱼跟纺织厂换的布，你有没有给大家做衣服呀？”
“留着过年给大家做衣服呢，现在有的穿就行了，急啥！”
张昊宇一阵无语，还是自己去买几套吧！
张昊宇穿上衣服，还好这个年代给小孩做的衣服都大很多，要不然根本穿不上！
他看着自己身上的衣服，无奈地叹了口气……

吃完饭，父亲和大哥去上班了，弟弟妹妹也准备好钓鱼用的东西。
张昊宇抱着两个小不点妹妹，一家人兴高采烈地来到北海！
找个合适地儿，张昊宇甩开膀子开始钓鱼。
他放开神识，惊喜地发现神识增加了10米，现在都有110米！收取物品的范围还是五十米！
刚钓上来几条鱼，父亲就带着两个人过来了。一个四十来岁的中年人，还有一个二十多岁的小年轻！
父亲指着中年人，“小宇，这位是我们厂里的后勤主任，范亮范主任。”
又指着年轻人说：“这位是采购员……”
年轻人自我介绍道：“我叫范家强。”父亲则指着张昊宇“范主任，这是我二儿子，张昊宇！”
张昊宇赶忙打招呼“范主任好，范同志好……”
范主任笑眯眯的，“你也好啊！我和你父亲在一个厂，都是自家人！我比你父亲大，你以后叫我范大爷，我叫你小宇。这是我侄子，你叫他范大哥，行不？”
“范大爷，范大哥。”范主任哈哈大笑，“好，好！真是一表人才啊！
这脸蛋，跟个小姑娘似的！这身体，壮实得很呐！衣服有点小了，来，从口袋里掏出票据，挑一挑。
把那张十尺布票递给张昊宇，“小宇，这是大爷给你的见面礼，拿去买身衣服！”
父亲连忙阻止，“范主任，这使不得，太贵重了！”
content_en:
When Zhang Haoyu opened his eyes, it was still dark. He raised his hand and looked at his watch. It was only five o'clock!
He ducked into the space, swallowed a drop of spiritual liquid, and began to practice the "Xuantian Immortality Technique".
Two hours later, he felt that he was about to break through, so he quickly took another drop of spiritual liquid with his mind and drank it. He then practiced for more than an hour, and with a bang, he broke through to the second level of Qi Refining!
He felt that his body had undergone tremendous changes, not only his strength had doubled.
My body has also become a lot stronger, and I have actually grown a little taller, now I am 1.76 meters tall! The mental power has been enhanced a lot!
Zhang Haoyu came to the yard and tried it, and his speed doubled!
He practiced boxing excitedly, and wow, his martial arts also broke through the hidden power! How strong is it exactly?
He hasn't fought with anyone since he was reborn, but he feels stronger than in his previous life!
He used his mind to cleanse his body, went to the warehouse, and scanned the textbooks from the police school with his spiritual consciousness. Then he walked out of the space and glanced at his watch. Only a few minutes had passed...
Zhang Haoyu was lying on the bed, happily digesting the knowledge in the textbooks of the public security school.
To him, this knowledge was so simple! Most of the police officers in this era are retired soldiers, and many of them don’t even know their names! Not to mention cultural knowledge!
Two little ones ran over, "Er Guo, Er Guo..."
Zhang Haoyu carried the two little ones to the bed, played with them for a while, and then got up and got dressed.
"Oh, why have my clothes become so small?"
"Mom..." When her mother heard him calling her, she hurried over and asked, "Xiaoyu, go wash up as soon as you get up. What's the matter with calling me?"
"Mom, you used the fish and the cloth from the textile factory, have you made clothes for everyone?"
"I'm saving it for the Chinese New Year to make clothes for everyone. I can wear whatever I have now. Why are you in a hurry!"
Zhang Haoyu was speechless for a while, so he might as well buy a few sets himself!
Zhang Haoyu put on his clothes. Fortunately, the clothes made for children in this era are much larger, otherwise he wouldn't be able to wear them at all!
He looked at his clothes and sighed helplessly...
After dinner, my father and eldest brother went to work, and the younger brothers and sisters also prepared things for fishing.
Zhang Haoyu hugged his two little sisters, and the family came to Beihai happily!
After finding a suitable place, Zhang Haoyu threw off his arms and started fishing.
He let go of his spiritual consciousness and was pleasantly surprised to find that his spiritual consciousness had increased by 10 meters and was now 110 meters! The range for collecting items is still fifty meters!
As soon as we caught a few fish, my father came over with two people. A middle-aged man in his forties, and a young man in his twenties!
The father pointed at the middle-aged man, "Xiaoyu, this is the logistics director of our factory, Director Fan Liangfan."
Then he pointed at the young man and said, "This is the buyer..."
The young man introduced himself: "My name is Fan Jiaqiang." The father pointed at Zhang Haoyu, "Director Fan, this is my second son, Zhang Haoyu!"
Zhang Haoyu hurriedly said hello, "Hello, Director Fan, hello Comrade Fan..."
Director Fan smiled and said, "It's good for you too! Your father and I work in the same factory, and we are both from the same family! I am older than your father. From now on, you will call me Uncle Fan, and I will call you Xiaoyu. This is my nephew. You can call him Brother Fan, okay?"
"Uncle Fan, Brother Fan." Director Fan laughed loudly, "Okay, okay! What a talented person!
This face looks like that of a little girl! This body is so strong! The clothes are a bit too small. Come on, take out the receipt from your pocket and pick them out.
He handed the ten-foot cloth ticket to Zhang Haoyu, "Xiaoyu, this is a meeting gift from the uncle, take it to buy some clothes!" "
His father quickly stopped him, "Director Fan, this is impossible, it's too expensive! "
